messages.subject: Re: Error in x - from[1] : non-numeric argument to binary operator
parts:
Hi Vivek,

I can't reproduce this [R version 2.8.1 (2008-12-22) ; ggplot2 version
0.8.1]. But one thing you could try to narrow such problems down, in
general, is to enter 'debug qplot' before the qplot command. Then you
can step through and see which line causes the error.

Another tip to help get a better answer is to provide the exact
version of R/ggplot2 you're using, as I did above (?qplot will show
the version at the bottom; printing R.version will show your version
of R).

-Dan

p.s. the following approximation of your data works for me:
> data <- data.frame(col1=rep(c("A","B"),each=14),
col2=runif(28,0,2000))
> qplot(col1, col2, data=data)

I did have the latest version of ggplot2 and R. Running on a MAC
OSX10.5

The sample code from Dan and Rob gave me the same error.

So I un-installed and re-installed R and that fixed the problem.

Cheers,
Vivek
